notes.title: Tutorial Mission, Battery System and Co-op Fixes – New Update Available
notes.notes:
🔦 Update – Tutorial mission, usage-limited items, and co-op fixes

Dear occult hunters,

A new update is now live for Whispers in the Dark!  
This version introduces helpful features for new players, improvements to item behavior, and important fixes for co-op sessions.

🆕 New Features

🎓 Tutorial Mission
A guided tutorial mission has been added!  
It helps new players get familiar with the core mechanics of the game in a simple and safe environment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735475/e8fc6afa850ab7d0cd8a40863fda941e6f3828d6.png
🧭 In-Game Help
- Mission objectives are now clearly listed in the mission dashboard.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735475/2756040a98d182fb33b90f3a1abe0a2fe0d540e7.png
- A dedicated Codex page explains communication with entities.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735475/3e817818f96ce378cd7a4ca25ccf5750aac4ebe1.png
- The number of remaining discoverable skills is now visible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735475/b4cd4753381f53825531461b4b91a0197bb5ab5c.png
🕯️ Items with Limited Duration or Uses
Certain tools now have a limited number of uses or active time:
- Candles, electronics, salt, talc, etc. can now burn out, lose charge, or be consumed.
- Once depleted, they are automatically removed from your inventory.

🔋 Battery Indicators
Devices powered by batteries now display a charge level, letting you anticipate when to replace or recharge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735475/603b9be525a0cad09bdd343ac641186dabfac936.png
🛠️ Fixes and Improvements

- Fixed voice chat issues in co-op  
- Improved display of teammates’ items  
- Various performance improvements and bug fixes

📣 Coming this September: A Major Update

A big content update is coming this September! Here's a sneak peek of what's planned:

🛠️ Pro and Legendary Equipment
Rare, powerful, and expensive – these items will give you an edge… if you survive long enough to use them.

👻 Equipment Interference & Destruction
The most powerful entities will be able to damage or destroy your gear if it's not of sufficient quality.  
Only legendary items will be immune to destruction.

🧭 New Mission Type: Rare Item Recovery
Special items will be hidden in the environment during active missions.  
These secret objectives must be discovered and unlocked by exploring.

Stay tuned – we’ll share more details in the weeks to come!
📣 Join the Community

🎧 Discuss, share your feedback, and follow upcoming updates on our Discord:  
[link=https://discord.gg/huxhf5w5Sx]https://discord.gg/huxhf5w5Sx[/link]

Thanks again for your continued support!  
👁️‍🗨️  
– The Whispers in the Dark Team

notes.title: 0.67 update
notes.notes:
Be prepared for Halloween with this new update directly inspired from our community feedbacks.

CHANGES

- Only 1 skill point for each skill level up
- No more item research
- Courtyard map : entity can walk outside
- Old saves : adds skill points for no penalties
- New identification system : a choice is proposed based our your entity knowledge

FIXES

- Interferences from entity may had some opposite consequences in coop game
- Sometimes, no missions were proposed after debriefing
- Van not visible in the mirror
- Codex display
- UI visible through mirror
- rotated camera after push spells
- research requirements not updated
- UI computer bugs
- Mental not initialized after mission
- Some clues not updated
- Special missions not deleted when finished
- Entity was casting a spell multiples times and sometimes dying
- Big objets telekinesis
- Demoniac fluids more easily activated
- Main goals not correctly updated
- Inventory problems for coop client players : no possibility to take an item in inventory
- Statistics and Hall of Fame menu

notes.title: 0.63 version
notes.notes:
CHANGES

- Difficulty changes
- Sound design : audio levels (footsteps, music..)
- Entity sensibilities for contact items changed

FIXES

- Polaroid : visible entity in the photo enables now fear.
- display problem for posed & activated tools is fixed.
- Current researh and discoveries are now fully saved.
- Microphone bug when unpowered fixed.
- Display missions problem fixed : when you have discovered a new place, there was a special mission in the team screen (yellow button), and a classic mission with this envrionment (grey button). Now only the special mission or the grey mission is displayed, depending of the completness of the special mission.
- After the mission, the face of players weren't initialized : the fear was kept on it. Fixed.
- Bug on Survive All fixed.
- Bug on the detection of the player using crystallball with success fixed.
